arms: Both minimize native GT logit margins and original-score drift on identical class/scale rows. Only A1 adds point classification loss. All GT boxes and regressor weights fixed. The teacher is not used in either arm.
model: Six final one-to-one classification Conv2d rows and biases. No extra inference op.
fit: Closed form ridge with uncentered column RMS and coefficient penalty 0.03. Target native confidence floors .60/.08, weak .75/.08, no update required beyond target. Preserve anchors include exact parent logits for top56 and seeded 40 random per level and all native fixed-threshold dense anchors in the additional high-anchor term.
weak_rule: Within original sampler support select strongest native same-branch hypothesis at the human-indicated pixel, centered within 0.55 of proposal extent and overlap >=.15 with the sampling proposal for identity only. Reject if any native GT IoU >=.10. Largest native probability across scales selects one row per class per reviewed site; no weak box supervision.
screen: Preexisting, reused 111 same-training-date frames held out by capture minute from these terminal updates; parent trained on all source frames. Must jointly add >=2 TP and no extra FP versus BOTH parent and A0; insect TP >= original parent. No threshold search. On failure stop before development inference/speed. Point replay is training behavior only.
